sloka: यज्ञभूम्यां तु विधिवत् पावकस्तेन रक्षसा।हूयमानः प्रजज्वाल मांसशोणितभुक् तदा ।। ६.८२.२७ ।।
transliteration: yajñabhūmyāṁ tu vidhivat pāvakastena rakṣasā।hūyamānaḥ prajajvāla māṁsaśoṇitabhuk tadā ।। 6.82.27 ।।

translations.english: The flame had swollen up with the offering of blood as oblation and risen. It was very bright and wrapped in the flames the fire resembled the sun.
